title: Detailed wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- band top -->
  <path d='M38 6 Q50 2 62 6 L64 20 Q50 16 36 20 Z' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <path d='M38 6 Q50 2 62 6 L62 9 Q50 6 38 9 Z' fill='#B0733A'/>
  <!-- band bottom -->
  <path d='M36 80 Q50 84 64 80 L62 94 Q50 98 38 94 Z' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <path d='M62 91 Q50 95 38 91 L38 94 Q50 98 62 94 Z' fill='#B0733A'/>
  <!-- band texture holes -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='2' fill='#5A3A1A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='93' r='2' fill='#5A3A1A'/>

  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='34' fill='#D9A441'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#E8B84B'/>
  <!-- bezel inner -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#2E3A59'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#3B4A70'/>

  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='82' y='46' width='7' height='8' rx='2' fill='#D9A441'/>
  <rect x='84' y='47' width='3' height='6' rx='1' fill='#A8791F'/>

  <!-- hour markers -->
  <g fill='#F4E9C1'>
    <rect x='49' y='28' width='3' height='7' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='49' y='65' width='3' height='7' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='28' y='48.5' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='65' y='48.5' width='7' height='3' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='62.5' y='34' width='3' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(45 64 35.5)'/>
    <rect x='34.5' y='34' width='3' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(45 36 35.5)'/>
    <rect x='62.5' y='63' width='3' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(45 64 64.5)'/>
    <rect x='34.5' y='63' width='3' height='3' rx='1' transform='rotate(45 36 64.5)'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#F7D968'>
    <rect x='50' y='30' width='1.5' height='4' rx='0.7'/>
    <rect x='50' y='66' width='1.5' height='4' rx='0.7'/>
    <rect x='30' y='49' width='4' height='1.5' rx='0.7'/>
    <rect x='66' y='49' width='4' height='1.5' rx='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='31' width='3' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#7DE3FF'/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <rect x='49' y='44' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#7DE3FF' transform='rotate(120 50 50)'/>
  <!-- second hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='29' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#F7D968'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1' fill='#2E3A59'/>

  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d='M34 34 Q42 26 54 27 Q40 32 36 42 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
